naming_clarity.reason: 'high-voltage' is spelled out and familiar to BEV drivers.

parent_fit.reason: Root of the V; no upstream parent.

single_user_capability.reason: Centred on HV safety but folds in two aspects - making the system safe and warning the driver - that could ship separately.
single_user_capability.suggestion: Keep the safe-state as the capability and phrase the warning as how the driver experiences it, or split into two stories.

user_observable.reason: The warning is observable, but 'making its high-voltage system safe' is an internal effect a driver cannot directly observe.
user_observable.suggestion: Express the safe state in driver terms, e.g. 'the vehicle stops providing high voltage and tells me it is safe/unsafe to continue'.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by spelled-out bev condition (var.powertrain.type == 'bev'); root, no parent.
